extract:
The catalog record identifies Nicolaus Copernicus as the creator of the 1543 work De revolutionibus.

The evidence records the work's publication in Nuremberg in 1543 and names Johannes Petreius's workshop as its printer.

The Library of Congress description presents the title page as stating a sun-centred model.

review.notes: Verified each sentence against the cited Library of Congress metadata passage; no broader significance or causation was added.

title: The 1543 publication of De revolutionibus
